question_declaration.question: Can the unchanged process-isolated recovery route finalize a walking segment that starts partway through a foot flight, preserve an exact integer-valued native terminal step without changing its retained number kind, and bind the interaction to the start receipt actually hashed by its producer?

diagnosed_boundaries.observation: At the matched-continuation start, front-right and rear-left are already airborne. Rear-left lands at global step 973, local step 11, after ten retained airborne rows. Its lift-off position is absent; subtraction and dot-product indexing each log an error.
diagnosed_boundaries.limits: The original two errors, claimed cycle count, raw evaluation, and invalid/incomplete closure remain unchanged.

diagnosed_boundaries.observation: Only exact_int(memory.last_semantic_step, completed_global_semantic_step) fails: retained native memory contains float 240.0 and the host count is int 240. The duplicated source number kinds, values, all other predicates, and all four hashes match.
diagnosed_boundaries.limits: This is not a damaged hash, empirical allowance, rounding permission, rewritten number, or terminal replacement.

diagnosed_boundaries.observation: After the terminal predicate is isolated in memory, the next refusal compares the producer's start-receipt hash with the completed session wrapper. The start hash recomputes exactly; the synthetic Python fixture repeats the wrong wrapper binding.
diagnosed_boundaries.limits: Bind the originally named producer source; do not accept either hash interchangeably or fall back to a wrapper.

walking_evaluator.rule: Count and measure a contact cycle only when its lift-off and touchdown were both observed inside this segment, with the unchanged minimum airborne dwell. Track an initial partial flight separately and exclude it from cycle and relocation claims.

terminal_consumer.rule: Use the already-qualified exact integer-valued native-step projection for the single retained terminal step field. Require finite integral value in the declared range, exact agreement with the host count, and unchanged matching source number kind across both memory copies.

interaction_consumer.rule: Pass and validate the exact start_receipt within the walking-prefix session; bind its session, model, axes, and digest. The completed wrapper is not an alternative source.

failure_retention.rule: Retain the complete walking evaluation input and a named failure receipt if evaluation is invalid. A valid behavioral negative remains complete; a script or engine-health failure remains invalid.

required_zero_world_coverage: Reopen the exact L13 closure, all ten retained files, five frozen Git sources, and the closed diagnosis; reproduce both consumer refusals in order and the rear-left missing operand without changing the result.

Exercise the real production v2 evaluator on initial grounded, initially airborne short and long partial flights, lift-off on the first row, exact dwell boundary, too-short dwell, completed cycles after a censored initial flight, and a flight still open at the end.

Reject missing or malformed vectors, non-Boolean contacts, missing rows, wrong session/local order, wrong source identity, threshold injection, and incomplete evaluation inputs without a script error.
Preserve every v1 fixed threshold and all 27 behavioral receipt names; zero completed cycles and an initial airborne foot must not pass the corresponding behavior gates.

Replay both complete L13 walking segments as development-only fixtures through the actual v2 evaluator; verify 720 and 1920 rows, exact complete-cycle counts, unchanged non-cycle measured quantities, and no error output. Do not replace the old evaluations.

Exercise the actual terminal consumer on int and integral-float complete/failed/refused terminals and range boundaries; reject booleans, fractional, nonfinite, strings, null, out-of-range, crossed source kinds, changed source memory, and all four damaged hashes.

Build baseline and active interaction fixtures through the production source shape, then call the actual independent consumer; reject wrapper hashes, absent or swapped starts, wrong session/model/axes, and altered payloads.
Run the actual child-data validation path end to end on production-shaped fixtures; retaining a failed engine-health receipt or an absent child must still prevent route acceptance.
Exercise invalid walking-evaluation retention with all already-observed rows and boundary sources; absence or tampering must fail closed.
Preserve all L13 native pre-parse, binary32 target, named ledger, failed-source retention, L12 handoff, L11 release, L10 nullable terminal, L9 process-isolation, and earlier controls.

Exercise the actual qualification wrapper, five production freeze/closure source-binding functions, historical/current adapter separation, and the complete prospective dependency manifest before official qualification.
All qualification models, worlds, scene insertions, native physics readbacks, body writes, and solver steps are zero.

authorization_boundary.next_required_boundary: A clean, pushed, live-equal distinct successor source; complete zero-world qualification; then a separately declared smallest coverage-adequate development route and separate prospective freeze/authority graph.
authorization_boundary.route_ghost_coverage_requirement: A later physical declaration must name the unexercised production paths, including child transition, interaction, active fall/recovery terminalization, walking finalization and failure retention. Extra cells or a full horizon require an explicit coverage argument; no held-out evidence can substitute.
